findings.label: Self-view never binds on join
findings.detail: startSelfView() assigns srcObject while the self-view <video> is unmounted (render gate `connected && selfViewOn`, but connected is still false when startSelfView runs in join()). selfView.current is null, the assignment is skipped, and nothing re-binds the stream once the element mounts on connect. The headline 'join shows your own video' fix does not display video. Fix: bind via a callback ref or a useEffect keyed on connected && selfViewOn.

findings.label: Camera double-open contention
findings.detail: startSelfView() holds its own getUserMedia video handle while Chime's startVideoInput opens the same camera; on single-open devices this throws NotReadableError and is misreported to the provider as 'the other participant will not see your video'. Share one MediaStream track with Chime, or release the self-view handle before startVideoInput, or distinguish the device-busy error message.

findings.label: Guard misses the HealthScribe upload window
findings.detail: The leave-Telehealth guard warns on recording, live room, and IN_PROGRESS transcription, but the post-recording upload state (uploading/retryAudio) lives inside NativeTelehealthRoom and is not visible to the page-level guard. Leaving mid-upload could drop the recording. Confirm whether upload can be in flight after IN_PROGRESS clears and, if so, extend the guard.
